name: orbit
description: ORBIT — Windows workspace broadcast to an iPad, with local gesture control

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @orbit/server && npm run build -w @orbit/receiver && npm run build -w @orbit/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/server --pretty false && tsc -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.main.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/receiver/tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
